message:
docs: reconcile superseded backlog and installed action boundaries

Preserve newer AI accounting fixes, remove duplicate and obsolete-format work, close the already repaired lexical/command-copy defects, and track typed fire-care routing through the existing finite activity owner. No new runtime qualification is claimed.

replacements.old: Reusable learned methods, richer output references, fire recovery and sustained survival remain (AC06/AC09).
replacements.new: AE already supplies acquired finite methods and committed multi-output bindings. Broader control/family coverage, fire recovery and sustained survival remain (AC06/AC09); do not rebuild the delivered learning/execution owner.

- [ ] **AC03.6 — Reconcile typed fire-care requests with the installed finite watch.** At reviewed source `bdaecaac`, `worlds/base/typed-requests.ts` still declares repeated fuelling unavailable. `typed-actions.ts` applies that authored revision before the installed activity-request path in `action-grounding.ts`, so “tend the fire until dawn” can offer only staying nearby and a request without a time can be refused for a capability that now exists. Route supported requests through PW10’s existing trusted compiler/admission; obtain the required fire, supply, finite deadline/fuel budget and mode rather than inventing them or adding a second watch executor. Keep truly unsupported indefinite care explicit. Qualify ordinary text, exact structured selection, missing parameters, no-AI behavior, refusal and confirmation without hidden fuel consumption or a paid retry. Update the [world wording](../worlds/base/typed-requests.md) from the same owner. This is a confirmed integration gap, not a claim that PW10 is absent or authorization for unlimited tending.

**Exit:** AX01–AX10, AX19–AX2

replacements.old: owner's [discussion-only proposal](../projects/embodied-survival-tech-design.md#learned-activities-discussion-only) would reuse successful methods without reselecting every normal step. AC06.3–AC06.5 remain open (AC06.1–AC06.2 are delivered for requested activities; see [below](#composed-activities-slice)): hunting needs a bounded repeat/stop condition, harvesting needs actual multiple-output bindings, and cooking needs current resource/location checks. Extend the saved AG03 frontier rather than add a parallel plan store. A cognition opportunity can offer the remaining activity alongside alternatives; a miss need not terminate it, whereas lost access, threat, unavailable heat or invalid outputs can require reconsideration. Completed receipts stay in memory/state even when omitted from the remaining-step display. No learned loop was implemented or silently substituted for the individual choices tested here
replacements.new: earlier [discussion-only survival proposal](../projects/embodied-survival-tech-design.md#learned-activities-discussion-only) did not authorize automatic learned routines. Subsequent [AE delivery](action-experience.md) implements personally acquired finite methods, actual output bindings, scoped offers and selected execution through the existing AG03 frontier. Requested holding/time predicates and bounded repetitions are also delivered; broader AC06.3–AC06.5 semantics and family coverage remain open. Reuse those owners rather than build a second plan or learning store. General conditional hunting/cooking routines, inferred branches and automatic survival policy are not established by the finite examples. A cognition opportunity may offer the remaining activity alongside alternatives; committed receipts persist even when omitted from that display. Current heat, access, outputs and resources still require native revalidation. The historical individual-choice trials remain what they measured, not evidence for the later learned-method path

## Elapsed-time cross-cutting reg

- [ ] Character lexical recall ([MH03](../limits/memory.md#mh03)) still matches through the database parser, which under a C-locale database glues non-ASCII punctuation to words and does not lowercase non-ASCII letters, so model recall can miss such words. Found 2026-09-29 during the player-history search review; [PW09](next-playable-week.md#pw09--correct-and-efficient-memory-retrieval) now proposes the shared normalizer plus parser-independent lexical serialization, with ranking/privacy qualification. The bug remains open until those checks pas
replacements.new: [PW09](next-playable-week.md#pw09--correct-and-efficient-memory-retrieval) now delivers the character lexical-recall repair: indexing and queries share Unicode normalization and use quoted lexical representations rather than the locale-sensitive text parser. The [PostgreSQL correctness and growth evidence](../verification/data-foundation.md#pw09--unicode-and-scoped-retrieval) records C/en_US.UTF-8, ranking, privacy, invalidation and current-format reopen checks. This supersedes the September 29 missing-implementation task; it does not close C17/PF08's large-history costs or the unsuccessful 100k-source checkpoint-restore case
